verdict.rationale: Snyk Container is a documented dedicated product for scanning container images, covering both OS-level and application-layer vulnerabilities via integrations across CI/CD, registries, and CLI (snyk-docs-7, snyk-docs-25). This is corroborated by the general CLI/test-workflow evidence and the broad product framing (scan code, dependencies, containers, IaC), though independent hands-on validation specific to container image scanning (vs. general CLI auth behavior) is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence specifically testing container image scans (OS-package layer detection), and detail on registry integration depth or base-image remediation guidance beyond docs claims.
